resources.string: Lets the keyboard read the conversation or form on screen so its suggestions fit what you\'re looking at. It scrolls only when you ask. Nothing leaves your phone.

When enabled, Agent Keyboard reads the text of the app you are typing in (for example, the last messages of a chat or the labels of a form) only while the keyboard is open, so replies and form-fill suggestions match the context. It never reads password fields, secure screens, or apps on your blocklist, and it never taps or types anything on your behalf. It scrolls the app only when you tap Read earlier messages or Read whole page in the keyboard, then scrolls it back. Everything stays on your device.
Shown while the assistant is drafting or sending a reply for you, or installing a model pack.
Downloading and verifying a model pack you chose
Shown while your keyboard agent can see the app above the keyboard.
Your agent can see the app above the keyboard. Frames stay in memory on this phone.
